items.text: College and career readiness skills for students include study habits, time management, written and spoken communication, digital tools, basic money sense and the ability to ask for help, and they are best built through small real tasks rather than lectures.
Pick two or three skills, practise them in real tasks like projects or clubs and keep a short record of what you did.
Judge them by practice and feedback, not promises.
